verdicts.reason: A actually rearranges the layout for the taller canvas: the headline sits on the left and the large product circle on the right. However, the Try It button butts into the bottom of the circle, and 'Out now.' is cut off from the headline and dangles beside the button, so it reads out of order. B is essentially the original banner moved into the top half of the canvas. The product circle is jammed into the top-left corner, the button floats at a different height from the headline, and about 40% of the canvas at the bottom is empty, which makes the layout badly unbalanced.
